verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented incorporation or formation service. Nothing covers charters, bylaws, initial board consents or founder stock purchases, and nothing describes an emerging-companies practice built around formation. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a generic statement that the firm advises start-ups, advice on 'standardizing their key documents', and a Prarambh incubator that 'helps them set up' but only admits registered businesses at least one year old.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice
